domain_report.description: Number of top-level and second-level destinations to show (-1 = unlimited)

domain_report_limit.description: Minimum number of requests required for domain entries to appear (0 = no limit)

domain_report_n_level.description: N-level domain reporting depth (>=2); 0 means use default 2nd-level reporting

requester_report.description: Number of requesters to show (-1 = unlimited)

requester_report_no_dns_lookup.description: Disable DNS lookups for IP addresses

requester_report_with_targets.description: Number of targets per requester to show (implies requester_report)

response_time_report_interval.description: Whitespace-separated list of response time interval boundaries (msec)

response_time_limit.description: Maximum response time (msec) to include in average (very slow requests skipped)

size_distribution_report.description: Size bucket width for reporting (2, 10, or 100)

type_report.description: Number of content types/extensions to show (-1 = unlimited)

ipfilter_exclude.description: Colon-separated IP ranges to exclude (requires NetAddr::IP Perl module)

ipfilter_include.description: Colon-separated IP ranges to include (requires NetAddr::IP Perl module)

no_input.description: Disable stdin input (use for cache files)
